question: Does causal memory of four depth views improve available terrain geometry over the same latest four-camera batch while native LQR remains unchanged?
scope: Offline ideal visibility-limited range sensing and geometry preview on one reused44s Gazebo/DART Mars figure-eight. No new physics runs, controller changes, SLAM or hardware claims.
body_state: Exact simulated pose and velocity at acquisition/anchor; not implemented state estimation.

cameras.noise: None; ideal range, exact calibration and exact pose
cameras.self_occlusion: First robot hit is masked invalid; never see through robot. Visible CAD/fork/belt geometry included and documented by adapter.

scene_boundary: Only private adapter and evaluator may access exact collisionDEM triangles and lava/rock feature meshes. Mapper receives depth/calibration/poses/timestamps only. Static crop includes every triangle AABB intersecting trace footprint expanded by range+mount margin. Fulltrace footprint only allocates simulator assets, never supplies map observations.
scene_backend: Native MuJoCo triangle raycasts, contingent on pre-campaign concave-mesh first-hit fixture; no dynamics integrated. Preserve fixture failures and exact assets.

map.unknown_rule: Query cell must be observed and query inside local support convex hull; otherwise abstain. No unknown flat fill.

anchors.snap: Nearest saved5ms index; deduplicate index and retain all strata

motion: Same anchor-pose/worldtranslation/bodyangularvelocity/jointrate constant-velocity integration for all arms; future executed motion never passed to preview.

contact_geometry.geometry: Known radius, cap opening and equatorial gap from model config. Geometry candidates only; retain ties and ideal rim candidates. Not force/loadshare prediction or exact segmented rim collision.

evaluation.primary_queries: At same CV-predicted centreXY for every arm, score surface availability; conditional verticalheight and geometric-face normal error against exact scene downwardray. Candidate contact points have a separate evaluation.
evaluation.actual_future_contacts: Saved future loaded-patch set and equivalent point used only by evaluator; nearest predictedcandidate distance and patchsetrecall also include motion-model error.
evaluation.normal_warning: Exact collisionface geometricnormal proxy, not forceweighted normal. Invalid/multifacet edge cases flagged or excluded with counts.
evaluation.timing: First observed relevant surface cell and available observation lead; geometric incomingpatch warnings are proxies, not force-transfer prediction.
evaluation.strata: Report uniform and dense separately; overlap is not an additional independent anchor.

predeclared_gates.integrity: No future frames, capture-time transforms, no terrain/contacts supplied to mapper, sameCV acrossarms, input/source hashes unchanged, visibility fixtures and meaningful tests pass.
predeclared_gates.interpretation: All utility criteria required to support further sensorfrontend work. Failure remains an informative retained result. Passing does not authorize or establish live control improvement. No outcome-based parameter retuning.

further_cases: Controlled planar-depth/occluding-object/robot-selfmask/cellunknown/multisurface fixtures; no broad closed-loop trajectorycampaign this iteration.
runtime: Measure render/map/query walltimes as offline runtime only; no realtimeclaim.
